meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 2 of 2022 adopting the final budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority for Fiscal Year 2022-2023.
votes.description: Adopts the final budget for the LBA Capital Projects Fund for FY2022-23, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries. The LBA is a financing tool that allows government entities to bond for capital projects at better interest rates.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA portion of the meeting and transition to the Redevelopment Agency meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 8 of 2022 approving the Fiscal Year 2023 RDA Budget reflected in the Key Changes spreadsheet with clarifications shown on the motion sheet, including $8,023,449 in capital projects approved for holding accounts.
votes.description: Adopts the RDA's FY2023 budget, approving specific capital project funds to be held in holding accounts across multiple project areas until specific project or program proposals are brought back to the Board.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined in items A through D regarding RDA budget and policy matters.
votes.description: Adopts four legislative intent statements covering new program funding allocations, equity and inclusion goals, early information and Board feedback, and updates from legislative sessions as they relate to RDA operations.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the RDA and reconvene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the RDA portion of the meeting and transition to the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of April 5, 2022, May 3, 2022 and May 17, 2022 and the formal meeting minutes of June 2, 2022.
votes.description: Approves four sets of prior meeting minutes from the City Council's work sessions and formal meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt joint ceremonial Resolution 15 of 2022 recognizing June 19, 2022 as Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing Juneteenth Freedom Day in Salt Lake City, honoring the significance of the holiday and contributions of community leaders for justice and equality.

votes.motion: Adopt joint ceremonial Resolution 16 of 2022 establishing a new Ballpark Legacy lease with the Salt Lake Bees Professional Baseball Franchise.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing the new Ballpark Legacy lease agreement with the Salt Lake Bees and the Larry H. Miller Company to enhance the ballpark community.

votes.motion: Adopt joint ceremonial Resolution 17 of 2022 declaring Salt Lake City's commitment to promoting equitable and inclusive language access.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall committing Salt Lake City to promoting equitable and inclusive language access for all residents.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G1-G4 to a future consent agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing for four grant applications (RAISE, Teen Afterschool Prevention, State Homeland Security Program, and EMPG grants) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 35 of 2022 amending Chapter 5.02, Salt Lake City Code, Available Methods of Delivering Records Related to Business Licensing.
votes.description: Amends City Code sections 5.02.080 and 5.02.110 to update the available methods of delivering records related to business licensing, as part of the FY2022-23 budget implementation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 36 of 2022 amending Chapter 15.16, Salt Lake City Code, Addressing Certain Fees for the Use and Cleaning of the City's Recreational Facilities.
votes.description: Amends the City Code to update fees for the use and cleaning of the City's recreational facilities as part of FY2022-23 budget implementation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 34 of 2022 adopting the rate of the tax levy, including the levy for the Library Fund, upon all real and personal property within Salt Lake City made taxable by law for Fiscal Year 2022-2023.
votes.description: Sets the property tax levy rate for Salt Lake City including the Library Fund levy for FY2022-23, as required for annual budget adoption.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 33 of 2022 approving the budget of the City Library Fund for Fiscal Year 2022-2023.
votes.description: Adopts the separately-budgeted Library Fund for FY2022-23 as part of the annual City budget adoption process.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 37 of 2022 amending the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule including a 6.2% increase to all fees paid into the General Fund and removing the meter obstruction fee.
votes.description: Amends the City's Consolidated Fee Schedule for FY2022-23 with a general 6.2% increase to General Fund fees and eliminates the meter obstruction fee.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 40 of 2022 appropriating necessary funds to implement, for Fiscal Year 2023, the provisions of the memorandum of understanding between Salt Lake City Corporation and the International Association of Firefighters Local 81, representing eligible employees in the Fire Department.
votes.description: Appropriates City funds to fulfill the MOU obligations with the firefighters' union (IAFF Local 81) for FY2022-23 compensation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 38 of 2022 appropriating necessary funds to implement, for Fiscal Year 2023, the provisions of the memorandum of understanding between Salt Lake City Corporation and the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees Local 1004, representing eligible employees in City departments.
votes.description: Appropriates City funds to fulfill the MOU obligations with AFSCME Local 1004 for FY2022-23 compensation for eligible City employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 39 of 2022 appropriating necessary funds to implement, for Fiscal Year 2023, the provisions of the memorandum of understanding between Salt Lake City Corporation and the Salt Lake Police Association, representing eligible employees in the Police Department.
votes.description: Appropriates City funds to fulfill the MOU obligations with the Salt Lake Police Association for FY2022-23 compensation for eligible police employees.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 41 of 2022 approving the Fiscal Year 2023 Compensation Plan for all non-represented employees of Salt Lake City Corporation.
votes.description: Establishes the compensation plan for all non-represented (non-union) City employees for FY2022-23 as part of the annual budget adoption.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 32 of 2022 approving Salt Lake City's Fiscal Year 2022-23 budget as outlined in the key changes spreadsheets and staffing document, excluding the schedule for capital projects and debt and the Library Fund.
votes.description: Adopts the main City operating budget for FY2022-23 (excluding the Library Fund and capital projects schedule) including the employment staffing document.

votes.motion: Approve $45,703,683 to be transferred into CIP, including approving $14,043,194 in funding as shown on the motion sheet, with the understanding that the placeholder for a first-year payment on a new sales tax revenue bond is not approved.
votes.description: Approves the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) funding transfer for FY2022-23, approving specific line items totaling $14,043,194 while deferring consideration of a proposed sales tax revenue bond to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt the Legislative Intent Statements as outlined on the motion sheet under Motion 5, items A through S.
votes.description: Adopts 19 legislative intent statements covering a wide range of City policy areas including diversified response teams, transit fare, traffic calming, sustainability, tenant services, fee schedules, grants, water usage, and departmental audits for FY2022-23.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent Agenda.
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda items including FY2022-23 Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 1) and five board appointments to the Business Advisory Board and Board of Appeals and Examiners.
